transcript.content: What are my heart rate zones?

Here are your current heart rate zones:

| Zone | Range | 
|------|-------|
| Zone 1 (Recovery) | < 143 bpm |
| Zone 2 (Endurance) | 143–157 bpm |
| Zone 3 (Tempo) | 157–164 bpm |
| Zone 4 (Threshold) | 164–174 bpm |
| Zone 5a (VO₂ Max) | 174–180 bpm |
| Zone 5b (Anaerobic) | 180–187 bpm |
| Zone 5c (Neuromuscular) | above 187 bpm |

These are based on your threshold heart rate of 176 bpm, using the Friel 5-zone model. Zone 5c has no upper cap — it's maximal, short-duration effort territory sanct.

Let me know if you want me to calculate these under a different model (like Karvonen), or if you'd like to see your power and pace zones too.

transcript.content: What are my heart rate zones?

- **Zone 1** — below 143 bpm (Recovery / Easy)
- **Zone 2** — 143–157 bpm (Aerobic / Endurance)
- **Zone 3** — 157–164 bpm (Tempo)
- **Zone 4** — 164–174 bpm (Sub-Threshold)
- **Zone 5a** — 174–180 bpm (Threshold)
- **Zone 5b** — 180–187 bpm (VO₂ Max)
- **Zone 5c** — above 187 bpm (Anaerobic / Sprint)

These use the Friel model (6-zone system with Zone 5 split into a/b/c). Zone 5c has no upper cap — it's all-out, maximal effort territory.

Want me to adjust these using a different model (e.g., Karvonen) or set up a periodized plan around them?
